CREATE PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMEREMAIL_CCD] AS
BEGIN

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail AS 
(SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerId,EmailTypeId ORDER BY INSERT_DTTM DESC ) RN, * FROM (
    ---- MONTHLY
    SELECT  
        BCM.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
        ,'Primary' AS EmailTypeId
        ,BCM.CUST_EMAIL_ADDR AS EmailAddress
        ,BCM.CUST_TIME_MAINT AS PeriodStartTimestamp
        ,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp
        ,NULL AS PreferenceId
        ,NULL AS CustomerEmailNote
        ,NULL AS DoNotDisturbIndicator
        ,NULL AS DateOfRequest
        ,BCM.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
        ,RECORD_STATUS
        ,insert_dttm
        ,'CCD' AS SourceCode
    FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER_DELTA BCMD
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER BCM
        ON BCMD.CUST_NBR = BCM.CUST_NBR AND BCMD.CUST_STATUS = BCM.CUST_STATUS  AND BCM.isLatest = 1
    WHERE BCM.CUST_EMAIL_ADDR NOT IN ('',' ')

    UNION 

    SELECT  
        BCM.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
        ,'Secondary' AS EmailTypeId
        ,BCM.CUST_EMAIL_ADDR2 AS EmailAddress
        ,BCM.CUST_TIME_MAINT AS PeriodStartTimestamp
        ,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp
        ,NULL AS PreferenceId
        ,NULL AS CustomerEmailNote
        ,NULL AS DoNotDisturbIndicator
        ,NULL AS DateOfRequest
        ,BCM.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
        ,RECORD_STATUS
        ,insert_dttm
        ,'CCD' AS SourceCode
    FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER_DELTA BCMD
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER BCM
        ON BCMD.CUST_NBR = BCM.CUST_NBR AND BCMD.CUST_STATUS = BCM.CUST_STATUS  AND BCM.isLatest = 1
    WHERE BCM.CUST_EMAIL_ADDR2 NOT IN ('',' ')

    UNION 

    SELECT  
        BCM.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
        ,'Tertiary' AS EmailTypeId
        ,BCM.CUST_EMAIL_ADDR3 AS EmailAddress
        ,BCM.CUST_TIME_MAINT AS PeriodStartTimestamp
        ,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp
        ,NULL AS PreferenceId
        ,NULL AS CustomerEmailNote
        ,NULL AS DoNotDisturbIndicator
        ,NULL AS DateOfRequest
        ,BCM.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
        ,RECORD_STATUS
        ,insert_dttm
        ,'CCD' AS SourceCode
    FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER_DELTA BCMD
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER BCM
        ON BCMD.CUST_NBR = BCM.CUST_NBR AND BCMD.CUST_STATUS = BCM.CUST_STATUS  AND BCM.isLatest = 1
    WHERE BCM.CUST_EMAIL_ADDR3 NOT IN ('',' ')

    UNION
    ------DAILY
    SELECT  
        BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
        ,'Primary' AS EmailTypeId
        ,BCD.CUST_EMAIL_ADDR AS EmailAddress
        ,BCD.CUST_TIME_MAINT AS PeriodStartTimestamp
        ,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp
        ,NULL AS PreferenceId
        ,NULL AS CustomerEmailNote
        ,NULL AS DoNotDisturbIndicator
        ,NULL AS DateOfRequest
        ,BCD.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
        ,RECORD_STATUS
        ,insert_dttm
        ,'CCD' AS SourceCode
    FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER_DELTA BCDD
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER BCD
        ON BCDD.CUST_NBR = BCD.CUST_NBR AND BCDD.CUST_STATUS = BCD.CUST_STATUS  AND BCD.isLatest = 1
    WHERE BCD.CUST_EMAIL_ADDR NOT IN ('',' ')

    UNION 

    SELECT  
        BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
        ,'Secondary' AS EmailTypeId
        ,BCD.CUST_EMAIL_ADDR2 AS EmailAddress
        ,BCD.CUST_TIME_MAINT AS PeriodStartTimestamp
        ,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp
        ,NULL AS PreferenceId
        ,NULL AS CustomerEmailNote
        ,NULL AS DoNotDisturbIndicator
        ,NULL AS DateOfRequest
        ,BCD.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
        ,RECORD_STATUS
        ,insert_dttm
        ,'CCD' AS SourceCode
    FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER_DELTA BCDD
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER BCD
        ON BCDD.CUST_NBR = BCD.CUST_NBR AND BCDD.CUST_STATUS = BCD.CUST_STATUS  AND BCD.isLatest = 1
    WHERE BCD.CUST_EMAIL_ADDR2 NOT IN ('',' ')

    UNION 

    SELECT  
        BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
        ,'Tertiary' AS EmailTypeId
        ,BCD.CUST_EMAIL_ADDR3 AS EmailAddress
        ,BCD.CUST_TIME_MAINT AS PeriodStartTimestamp
        ,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp
        ,NULL AS PreferenceId
        ,NULL AS CustomerEmailNote
        ,NULL AS DoNotDisturbIndicator
        ,NULL AS DateOfRequest
        ,BCD.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
        ,RECORD_STATUS
        ,insert_dttm
        ,'CCD' AS SourceCode
    FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER_DELTA BCDD
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER BCD
        ON BCDD.CUST_NBR = BCD.CUST_NBR AND BCDD.CUST_STATUS = BCD.CUST_STATUS  AND BCD.isLatest = 1
    WHERE BCD.CUST_EMAIL_ADDR3 NOT IN ('',' ')
)A
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail WHERE RN = 1;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,EmailTypeId
,EmailAddress
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,FinancialInstitutionId
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, RECORD_STATUS, EmailTypeId,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(PeriodStartTimestamp, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS PeriodStartTimestamp, FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCECODE
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,EmailTypeId
,EmailAddress
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,FinancialInstitutionId
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, EmailTypeId,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(PeriodStartTimestamp, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS PeriodStartTimestamp, FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCECODE
FROM BNKM.CustomerEmail  WHERE SourceCode = 'CCD'	AND PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.EmailTypeId,TGT.EmailTypeId) AS EmailTypeId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.PeriodStartTimeStamp,TGT.PeriodStartTimeStamp) AS PeriodStartTimeStamp
    ,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.SOURCECODE,TGT.SOURCECODE) AS SOURCECODE
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND SRC.EmailTypeId = TGT.EmailTypeId
AND SRC.PeriodStartTimeStamp = TGT.PeriodStartTimeStamp
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SOURCECODE = TGT.SOURCECODE

WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_DELTA;

----UPDATE RECORDS to BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndTimestamp = convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) 
FROM BNKM.CustomerEmail TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND DELTA.EmailTypeId = TGT.EmailTypeId AND DELTA.PeriodStartTimeStamp = TGT.PeriodStartTimeStamp AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.SOURCECODE = TGT.SOURCECODE  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  AND SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND SRC.EmailTypeId = TGT.EmailTypeId AND SRC.PeriodStartTimeStamp = TGT.PeriodStartTimeStamp AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND SRC.SOURCECODE = TGT.SOURCECODE 
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL

---INSERT RECORDS WITH UPDATE
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerEmail  ( 
CustomerId 
,EmailTypeId 
,EmailAddress 
,PeriodStartTimestamp 
,PeriodEndTimestamp 
,PreferenceId 
,CustomerEmailNote 
,DoNotDisturbIndicator 
,DateOfRequest
,SourceCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
	SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
	,SRC.EmailTypeId  AS EmailTypeId
	,SRC.EmailAddress  AS EmailAddress
    ,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS PeriodStartTimestamp
	,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp 
	,NULL AS PreferenceId 
	,NULL AS CustomerEmailNote 
	,NULL AS DoNotDisturbIndicator 
	,NULL AS DateOfRequest
	,'CCD' AS SourceCode
	,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,SRC.Insert_Dttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_DELTA DELTA ON  DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId AND DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId AND DELTA.EmailTypeId = SRC.EmailTypeId AND convert(varchar,DELTA.PeriodStartTimeStamp) = convert(varchar,SRC.PeriodStartTimeStamp) AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.SOURCECODE = SRC.SOURCECODE  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'

 


-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerEmail  ( 
CustomerId 
,EmailTypeId 
,EmailAddress 
,PeriodStartTimestamp 
,PeriodEndTimestamp 
,PreferenceId 
,CustomerEmailNote 
,DoNotDisturbIndicator 
,DateOfRequest
,SourceCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
	CustomerId AS CustomerId
	,EmailTypeId  AS EmailTypeId
	,EmailAddress  AS EmailAddress
    ,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(PeriodStartTimestamp, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS PeriodStartTimestamp
	,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp 
	,NULL AS PreferenceId 
	,NULL AS CustomerEmailNote 
	,NULL AS DoNotDisturbIndicator 
	,NULL AS DateOfRequest
	,'CCD' AS SourceCode
	,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,Insert_Dttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_DELTA;

END
GO
